title: 第2441章 等等看第2440章 向大少爷打听个人
content_zh:
明明已经确定李寒雪和陆玉镜没有来过宝鹤郡，更不可能被带进萧府了。
但此刻的陆天明却显得很是愤怒。
他抬起脚，对着趴在地上的萧易行便是一顿猛踹。
在宝鹤郡可谓无法无天的萧大少爷，此刻像条丧家之犬一样，双手抱头不停的哼唧着。
大概十数息的时间之后，陆天明终于“消气”。
他蹲下身子，伸手抓住萧易行那头保养得极好的秀发。
然后轻声问道：“痛吗？”
被踹得鼻子口来血的萧易行眨着那双无辜的眼睛。
声音颤抖道：“痛！”
陆天明忽地笑了笑，问道：“你到底是不是九重天？”
萧易行扯着嘴角道：“货真价实的九重天。”
“那为什么这么弱？”陆天明又道。
萧易行面上浮现出尴尬之色：“好事儿...好事儿做多了，最近身子骨不太行...”
“你口里的好事儿，是说接济那些女子？”陆天明奇道。
萧易行想要点头，奈何头发被人抓着。
只能忍着痛龇牙咧嘴道：“好汉，我虽然是别人口中的纨绔，但坏事做得极少...”
话没说完。
陆天明便打断道：“强抢民女，也是好事儿？”
听到这话。
萧易行倒吸一口气，整个人露出非常无辜的表情。

“好汉，你听谁说的我强抢民女了？”
“你在这宝鹤郡跟个土皇帝一样，看上谁的话，不是直接抢？还需要听谁说？”陆天明想当然道。
“哎哟...”萧易行差点昏了过去，“我说好汉，我确实像你说的那样在宝鹤郡可谓是土皇帝，可是我也有自己的原则好不好，实不相瞒，我这辈子从来没有强迫过任何一个女人，都是她们自愿的好吗...”
不等陆天明接话。
他又道：“何况，很多女子都有自己的困难，我替她们解决困难，怎么就算是坏事了？难道不是行善积德？”
陆天明望着萧易行那张比自己要帅气些许的脸颊。
突然间眉头一皱，猛地一松手，萧易行没反应过来，面部嘭的一声砸在了地面上。
听闻萧易行哎哟一声叫唤后。
陆天明再次探手抓住萧易行的头发，将后者的脑袋提了起来。
仔细一望，刚才那一下，直接磕断了萧易行的两颗门牙，以至于他的相貌看上去直线下滑。
“这样看着就舒服多了。”陆天明露出了一个古怪的笑容。
content_en:
It was clearly determined that Li Hanxue and Lu Yujing had never been to Baohe County, and it was impossible for them to be brought into the Xiao Mansion.
But at this moment, Lu Tianming looked very angry.
He raised his foot and kicked Xiao Yixing hard on the ground.
Young Master Xiao, who was considered lawless in Baohe County, was like a bereaved dog, holding his head in his hands and moaning non-stop.
After about ten breaths of time, Lu Tianming finally "calmed down".
He knelt down and reached out to grab Xiao Yixing's well-maintained hair.
Then he asked softly: "Does it hurt?"
Xiao Yixing, who was kicked until his nose and mouth were bleeding, blinked his innocent eyes.
His voice trembled: "It hurts!"
Lu Tianming suddenly smiled and asked, "Are you a Jiuchongtian?"
Xiao Yixing pulled the corners of his lips and said: "The genuine Nine Heavens."
"Then why are you so weak?" Lu Tianming asked again.
A look of embarrassment appeared on Xiao Yixing's face: "Good things...I have done too many good things, and my body is not doing well recently..."
"The good thing you are talking about is helping those women?" Lu Tianming asked curiously.
Xiao Yixing wanted to nod, but someone grabbed his hair.
He could only endure the pain and grinned: "Hero, although I am what others call a playboy, I have done very few bad things..."
The words were not finished.
Lu Tianming interrupted: "Is it a good thing to rob civilian girls by force?"
Hear this.
Xiao Yixing took a breath and showed a very innocent expression.
"Hero, who told you that I raped a girl?"
"You are like a local emperor in Baohe County. If you like someone, don't you just grab it? Who else do you need to listen to?" Lu Tianming said naturally.
"Ouch..." Xiao Yixing almost fainted, "I'm talking about a good man, I am indeed a local emperor in Baohe County as you said, but I also have my own principles, okay? To be honest, I have never forced any woman in my life, it is all of their own free will..."
Don't wait for Lu Tianming to answer.
He added: "Besides, many women have their own difficulties. How can it be considered a bad thing if I solve them for them? Isn't it a good deed?"
Lu Tianming looked at Xiao Yixing's face, which was slightly more handsome than his own.
Suddenly he frowned and let go suddenly. Xiao Yixing didn't react, and his face hit the ground with a bang.
After hearing Xiao Yixing's ouch call.
Lu Tianming reached out and grabbed Xiao Yixing's hair again and lifted the latter's head up.
A closer look revealed that the blow just now had directly broken two of Xiao Yixing's front teeth, causing his appearance to plummet.
"It feels much more comfortable to watch like this." Lu Tianming showed a weird smile.
